teestock.tagline: Wear Your Identity, Stock Your Story
teestock.status: Fase 1: Launching Preparation (Validasi DTF, In-House Heat Press, Drop #01)
teestock.tech_stack: React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Supabase PostgreSQL (RLS) + Cloudinary CDN + Vercel PWA

production_model.garment: New States Apparel (NSA Heavyweight 24s & Softstyle 30s) via Cititex
production_model.pressing: In-house heat press mandiri di rumah (suhu 155°C, 15s cold peel + 5s finishing press)
production_model.advantage: Hemat jasa press vendor Rp 5.000 - Rp 7.000/kaos, SLA produksi cepat H+0 s/d H+1

teestock.inventory_strategy: Hybrid 2-Tier: Tier 1 Buffer Studio fast-moving (Hitam/Putih M, L, XL) vs Tier 2 Virtual JIT Cititex (1.500+ SKU warna/model)

curated_drop_01.target_quota: 24 pcs kuota peluncuran early bird (Rp 89.000 - Rp 99.000)
curated_drop_01.exit_criteria_fase_1: Minimal 5-10 penjualan pertama ke circle terdekat + testimoni nyata

multigraph.strategic_role: Supporting packaging and collateral arm for TeeStock (hangtag, thank-you cards, polymailer seals, packaging box) before expanding to external B2B clients

titik_buta.strategic_role: Tunda hingga TeeStock stabil mencapai arus kas positif
